description: The AMSC activity places students at three stations — wavefront sensing, wavefront correction, and systems characterization.
title: Multi-station investigation with a hands-on wavefront-correction engineering challenge

description: In the AOSS lab activity, students first trace the light path, identify parts, and draw a quantitatively accurate ray trace and block diagram.
title: Disassemble-and-rebuild consensus task for teaching optical conjugation and relays

description: In this short activity, students familiar with some AO terminology are shown the functioning system with minimal explanation and, as a team, trace light through it and draw block diagrams and ray traces.
title: Guided systems-diagramming warm-up on a functioning AO workbench

description: For deeper investigation, students introduce various aberrations and time dependencies and vary software parameters such as gain and aggressiveness, which apply corrections to the DM from 10 to 60 times per second.
title: Systems optimization activity varying aberrations, speed and software parameters
